[Act: limitation
 Chapter: Third Division · Part I · Applications in Specified Cases
 Section: 128::Thirty days.
]


For possession by one dispossessed of immovable property and disputing the right of the decree-holder or purchaser at a sale in execution of a decree.
Period of limitationThirty days.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the dispossession.
